description:
Fifteen years ago, his father, fighting against unfair dismissal, took his own life amidst the indifference of a conglomerate. Before the shock had even subsided, his younger brother vanished without a trace. Faced with a series of tragedies, his parents ultimately passed away, leaving Do-jun alone. Since that day, when everything was taken from him, Do-jun has lived for revenge and truth. Realizing that he could not change anything without standing at the center of power, He endured his lonely days with the sole goal of becoming a politician. And on the day he finally received his diploma, he swore before his parents' urns:

*"I will find Yu-ri and bring her here to this very place."

"And those bastards...I will make them shed tears of blood."*

That night, Do-jun had his first "dream of the future." A vision too vivid to be a coincidence. And that dream foreshadowed the brutal path he would take in politics.

(Source: Naver, translated)
